nodes.description: Ownable private address _owner; authorization anchor for onlyOwner functions.
mapping(address => uint256) _rOwned: reflection balances updated on every transfer.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances: ERC20 spending approvals.
mapping(address => bool) _isExcludedFromFee: fee exemption whitelist.
mapping(address => bool) _bots: blacklist checked in every _transfer.
uint256 _rTotal: total reflections, reduced by _reflectFee.
uint256 _tFeeTotal: cumulative token fees reflected.
uint256 _taxFee: reflection fee percentage (settable, <= 1).
uint256 _teamFee: team fee percentage (settable, <= 7).
address payable _FeeAddress: de-facto admin credential used by all privileged setters.
address payable _marketingWalletAddress: second ETH recipient.
IUniswapV2Router02 uniswapV2Router: external router target of swaps and liquidity.
address uniswapV2Pair: created in openTrading, drives buy-side logic.
bool tradingOpen: gate required before pair buys are allowed.
bool _noTaxMode: globally disables fees when true.
bool inSwap: reentrancy guard toggled by lockTheSwap around router swaps.
uint256 walletLimitDuration: timestamp until which anti-whale wallet cap applies.
constructor paying FeeAddress/marketingWalletAddress, mints _rTotal to deployer and seeds fee exemptions.
ERC20 transfer(): forwards _msgSender(), recipient, amount to _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom(): performs _transfer then decrements allowance via SafeMath.sub.
ERC20 approve(): delegates to _approve for _msgSender().
_transfer(): core routing logic with blacklist, trading gate, wallet limit, auto-swap and fee decision.
swapTokensForEth(): approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH on the router under lockTheSwap.
sendETHToFee(): splits ETH with integer division and pushes to fee wallets.
_tokenTransfer(): conditionally strips/restores fees around _transferStandard.
_transferStandard(): applies reflection math and rewrites _rOwned balances.
_takeTeam(): converts team tokens to reflections credited to the contract.
_reflectFee(): decrements _rTotal and increments _tFeeTotal.
openTrading(): onlyOwner setup that creates the pair, adds liquidity and enables trading.
setMarketingWallet(): privileged replacement of the marketing wallet and its fee exemption.
excludeFromFee(): privileged whitelisting of a fee-exempt address.
includeToFee(): privileged removal of a fee exemption.
setNoTaxMode(): privileged global fee kill-switch.
setTeamFee(): privileged team fee update bounded by require(team <= 7).
setTaxFee(): privileged tax fee update bounded by require(tax <= 1).
setBots(): onlyOwner loop blacklisting addresses (unbounded array).
delBot(): onlyOwner removal from the bot blacklist.
manualswap(): privileged manual swap of the whole contract token balance.
manualsend(): privileged manual ETH disbursement to fee wallets.
receive(): accepts plain ETH, funded by router swaps.
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner transfer of ownership to address(0).
_approve(): writes _allowances and emits Approval with zero-address checks.
msg.sender exposed through _msgSender(); drives ownership and privileged checks.
block.timestamp used for wallet limit window and swap/liquidity deadlines.
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with deadline block.timestamp and amountOutMin 0.
ETH pushes to _FeeAddress and _marketingWalletAddress using amount.div(2).
External router.addLiquidityETH call funded with the full contract balance during openTrading.
Grouped privileged state mutations (fees, tax mode, marketing wallet, manual swap/send) authorized only by comparing _msgSender() to _FeeAddress.
_transfer parameter `from`: source address, blacklist and pair checks.
_transfer parameter `to`: destination address, blacklist and wallet-limit checks.
_transfer parameter `amount`: transferred token amount.
transfer parameter `recipient` forwarded to _transfer.
setBots parameter `bots_`: array of addresses to blacklist.
setTeamFee parameter `team`: new team fee, require(team <= 7).
setTaxFee parameter `tax`: new tax fee, require(tax <= 1).
setMarketingWallet parameter `marketingWalletAddress`: replacement ETH recipient.
_transferStandard parameter `tAmount`: token amount converted into reflection values.
Local contractTokenBalance capped at 5% of the pair balance before swapping.
Local takeFee flag toggling removeAllFee/restoreAllFee.
Local currentRate from _getRate() used to convert team tokens to reflections.

edges.reason: constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender(), i.e. directly from msg.sender.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares _owner with _msgSender().
privileged fee setters authorize the caller with require(_msgSender() == _FeeAddress).
_FeeAddress value is the sole authorization credential for all privileged operations.
half of the withdrawn ETH is transferred to _FeeAddress.
the remaining half of the ETH is transferred to _marketingWalletAddress.
walletLimitDuration > block.timestamp decides whether the anti-whale wallet cap applies.
router swap deadline is set to block.timestamp.
openTrading derives walletLimitDuration and the liquidity deadline from block.timestamp.
external swap deadline depends on miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
transfer() calls _transfer with _msgSender(), recipient and amount.
transferFrom() calls _transfer(sender, recipient, amount).
transferFrom() calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
_transfer terminates by invoking _tokenTransfer with the takeFee flag.
_transfer swaps accumulated contract tokens to ETH mid-execution.
_transfer pushes accumulated contract ETH to the fee wallets.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to settle balances.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team share.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection share.
_transferStandard writes _rOwned[sender] and _rOwned[recipient].
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)] with the team reflections.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call guarded by lockTheSwap.
the external swap executes before token balances are settled in _tokenTransfer; the inSwap guard blocks reentrant swaps.
openTrading calls router.addLiquidityETH with the whole contract balance.
the pair produced by factory.createPair is stored in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen = true.
_transfer requires tradingOpen for buys originating from the pair.
_transfer requires !_bots[from] && !_bots[to].
setBots flags addresses into _bots.
delBot clears the _bots flag for an address.
_taxFee feeds the fee computation used during transfer.
_teamFee feeds the team fee computation used during transfer.
manualswap swaps the full contract token balance via swapTokensForEth.
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance via sendETHToFee.
setMarketingWallet updates _isExcludedFromFee for the old and new wallet.
setNoTaxMode toggles _noTaxMode.
setTeamFee writes _teamFee after the bound check.
setTaxFee writes _taxFee after the bound check.
inSwap acts as the reentrancy guard consulted before swapTokensForEth runs.
from == uniswapV2Pair selects the buy branch with trading gate and wallet cap.
uniswapV2Router is the external target of the swap call and the WETH query.
approve() delegates to _approve for _msgSender().
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances with SafeMath.sub.
walletLimitDuration bounds the anti-whale window checked in _transfer.
amount.div(2) truncates; odd wei are never distributed and stay locked in the contract.
excludeFromFee sets _isExcludedFromFee[ad] = true.
includeToFee sets _isExcludedFromFee[ad] = false.
excludeFromFee is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
includeToFee is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
setMarketingWallet is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
setNoTaxMode is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
setTeamFee is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
setTaxFee is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
manualswap is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
manualsend is privileged, guarded only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress.
_isExcludedFromFee[from]/[to] determines whether takeFee is disabled.
_noTaxMode forces takeFee to false in _transfer.
amount parameter drives all balance and fee math in _transfer.
from parameter is debited and checked against _bots and the pair.
to parameter is credited and constrained by the wallet limit when buying.
recipient parameter is forwarded by transfer() into _transfer.
bots_ array is iterated to set _bots flags.
team parameter is validated and written into _teamFee.
tax parameter is validated and written into _taxFee.
arbitrary marketingWalletAddress replaces _marketingWalletAddress and gains a fee exemption.
tAmount parameter drives the fee/reflection math in _transferStandard.
the capped contractTokenBalance is the swap input passed to swapTokensForEth.
takeFee flag toggles removeAllFee/restoreAllFee in _tokenTransfer.
currentRate converts tTeam into the rTeam credited by _takeTeam.

normalization_plan.reason: `from` is a private helper parameter only consumed by _transfer; it has no independent lifecycle.
`to` is only used inside _transfer for blacklist and wallet-limit checks.
`amount` is a transient value passed to _transfer and immediately consumed.
`recipient` exists only to be forwarded by transfer() into _transfer.
`bots_` is a one-shot calldata array iterated by setBots and never stored as such.
`team` is validated then written to _teamFee inside setTeamFee only.
`tax` is validated then written to _taxFee inside setTaxFee only.
`marketingWalletAddress` is stored directly into _marketingWalletAddress by setMarketingWallet.
`tAmount` is an intermediate token amount used solely inside _transferStandard.
the capped local balance is immediately consumed as the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
`currentRate` is a transient rate used to compute the team reflection in _takeTeam.
